query: Add retries to this HTTP client's fetch_user call so transient failures don't surface to callers.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/crash-only.md and reference/tests.md before writing the change
Caps retries with a named constant and uses exponential backoff with jitter
Gives every call a timeout, and returns an error (not a panic) when retries are exhausted
Retries only idempotent requests, or adds an idempotency key
The test injects the operation, uses zero delay, and asserts the exact attempt list

query: Load the database URL and the server port from environment variables and pass them to the app.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/config.md before writing the change
Reads the environment once at the edge into a typed config value; the parser takes env as a parameter
Treats every value as required: a missing or malformed value fails at startup and names the variable, with no dev default
Passes each function the narrowest slice it uses (a DbUrl or a port), not the whole config
Tests pass env as a map and never mutate process environment variables

query: Add an endpoint that lets a customer cancel a booking. Cancelling an already-cancelled or expired booking should be rejected.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/http-apis.md before designing the endpoint
Models the action as a resource, e.g. POST /v1/bookings/{id}/cancellation
Returns the rejections as named, expected failures in one closed union, not as panics or booleans
Maps the result union to HTTP status and stable error code values in exactly one place, with no wildcard arm
States whether the operation is safe to repeat, and has one test per error variant that asserts the variant before the payload

query: Add an endpoint that fetches a URL the user pastes and returns its page title, for link previews. Only members of the workspace may call it.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/security.md and reference/http-apis.md before writing the endpoint
Checks that the caller belongs to the specific workspace in the path, not only that they are logged in, and has a test for a member of another workspace
Allowlists the scheme, rejects loopback, private, link-local, and reserved addresses among all resolved IPs, connects to the checked IP, and does not follow redirects
Gives the outbound fetch a timeout and caps the response size it reads
Treats the fetched page as untrusted input and escapes the title before returning it

query: test_checkout_total fails on CI about one run in five but always passes on my laptop. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/debugging.md and reference/tests.md before editing code
Tries to reproduce first: runs the test alone and in the full suite, with the CI seed, and under repetition, before changing code
Names a single hypothesis (shared state, ordering, time, or a race) and tests it by changing one thing
Fixes the cause where the wrong value is produced, not by adding a retry, a sleep, or a loosened assertion
Does not skip, delete, or quarantine the test as the fix, and removes any temporary debug output

query: Review this diff before I merge it: it adds a discount calculation to checkout and refactors the cart module.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/reviews.md before writing the review
Traces the callers and tests that reach each changed line before reporting a finding, and drops findings they rule out
Prefixes each finding with a severity, gives file:line and the breaking input, and orders correctness before style
Separates defects this change introduced from pre-existing ones
Asks for the refactor and the behavior change to be split into separate commits, and flags any test that the refactor had to change
